# MCP tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/generate.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

The MCP endpoint at `/mcp` exposes 25 curated tools. Every tool is
scoped, and `tools/list` returns only the tools the presented API key or OAuth
grant can invoke. The same definitions drive the server and the Settings screen,
so this page cannot drift from the implementation.

| Tool                   | Scope               | Kind        | What it does                                                                                                          |
| ---------------------- | ------------------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `list_tags`            | `tags:read`         | read        | List every tag with its subscriber count.                                                                             |
| `create_tag`           | `tags:write`        | write       | Create a tag. Names are normalised to lower case.                                                                     |
| `list_subscribers`     | `subscribers:read`  | read        | List subscribers newest first. Supports free-text search, tag filter, status filter and cursor pagination.            |
| `get_subscriber`       | `subscribers:read`  | read        | Read one subscriber together with their tags and custom metadata.                                                     |
| `create_subscriber`    | `subscribers:write` | write       | Create a subscribed subscriber with optional custom metadata.                                                         |
| `update_subscriber`    | `subscribers:write` | write       | Update a subscriber email, name or custom metadata. Metadata keys are merged; null clears a key through the REST API. |
| `delete_subscriber`    | `subscribers:write` | destructive | Soft delete a subscriber and stop future sends.                                                                       |
| `assign_tag`           | `subscribers:write` | write       | Attach one existing tag to one subscriber.                                                                            |
| `remove_tag`           | `subscribers:write` | write       | Detach one tag from one subscriber.                                                                                   |
| `bulk_tag_subscribers` | `subscribers:write` | write       | Add and remove tags across many subscribers in one call.                                                              |
| `list_campaigns`       | `campaigns:read`    | read        | List campaigns newest first with their status and audience size.                                                      |
| `get_campaign`         | `campaigns:read`    | read        | Read one campaign, including its audience query and pinned template revision.                                         |
| `create_campaign`      | `campaigns:write`   | write       | Create a draft campaign pinned to a template revision. Use preview_audience to check the audience before scheduling.  |
| `update_campaign`      | `campaigns:write`   | write       | Edit a draft campaign. All fields except id are optional.                                                             |
| `preview_audience`     | `campaigns:read`    | read        | Compile an audience query and return how many subscribers it matches right now.                                       |
| `schedule_campaign`    | `send:write`        | write       | Pin the template and audience, then schedule the campaign for a future Unix timestamp.                                |
| `send_campaign_now`    | `send:write`        | destructive | Pin the template and audience, then dispatch the campaign immediately.                                                |
| `pause_campaign`       | `send:write`        | write       | Pause a campaign that is currently sending.                                                                           |
| `resume_campaign`      | `send:write`        | write       | Resume a paused campaign and enqueue its remaining recipients.                                                        |
| `get_campaign_stats`   | `campaigns:read`    | read        | Read recipient status counts, unique opens, unique clicks and click-through rate.                                     |
| `list_templates`       | `templates:read`    | read        | List email templates by most recently updated.                                                                        |
| `get_template`         | `templates:read`    | read        | Read one template including its IR document and current revision.                                                     |
| `create_template`      | `templates:write`   | write       | Create a template from an IR document. The document must be a valid email IR object.                                  |
| `update_template`      | `templates:write`   | write       | Edit a template. Pass bumpRevision=false for an autosave that does not change the pinned revision.                    |
| `preview_template`     | `templates:read`    | read        | Render a template to HTML and plain text. Set applyMergeTags to preview with sample subscriber data.                  |

## Scopes and tool counts

| Scope               | Tools |
| ------------------- | ----- |
| `subscribers:read`  | 2     |
| `subscribers:write` | 6     |
| `campaigns:read`    | 4     |
| `campaigns:write`   | 2     |
| `templates:read`    | 3     |
| `templates:write`   | 2     |
| `tags:read`         | 1     |
| `tags:write`        | 1     |
| `media:write`       | 0     |
| `send:write`        | 4     |
| `emails:write`      | 0     |
| `events:write`      | 0     |
| `webhooks:read`     | 0     |
| `webhooks:write`    | 0     |

Tool definitions live in `packages/api/src/mcp/tools.ts`; scopes live in
`packages/shared/src/scopes/index.ts`.

## Schemas

Call `tools/list` against a running instance to receive the live JSON Schema for
each tool. The schemas are built from the same Zod contracts the REST API uses;
this page intentionally does not duplicate them.

## Transport

`/mcp` is a Streamable HTTP endpoint, not a JSON REST route. It accepts scoped
`pwr_` API keys directly, session cookies, or an OAuth 2.1 access token issued
through `/oauth/authorize`. See [Agent access](../agent-access.md) for setup.
